subject: Recap + ask: regional cost delta and budget bands (US vs EU) - next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Arianna Gomez <arianna@helixpay.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@helixpay.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: regional cost delta and budget bands (US vs EU) - next steps

Hi Arianna / Tom —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Quick recap of what I heard and a few asks so we can size a pilot correctly: 

What I captured
- Expected usage profile: 8–12M tokens/month initially, bursty on payroll runs (spikes up to ~18M).
- Primary requirement: EU data residency for customer PII and payment flows.
- Decision timeline: target procurement decision in 4–6 weeks.

Pricing & unit-econ assumptions (baseline) — please confirm these are in the right ballpark: 
- Target unit price: $700–$1,000 per 1M tokens (for hosted API in US region).
- EU residency delta: approx +15–20% on unit price (lower effective throughput due to smaller regional pools + cross-region egress for replication).
- Private/VPC deployment delta: additional +10–25% depending on isolation and retention needs (HSM/KMS).

If HelixPay is aiming for 10M tokens/mo and we use $900 per 1M as the mid, that implies ~$9k/mo in API spend (hosted US). With EU residency at +18% the same workload looks like ~$10.6k/mo.

Attachments: attaching a short price sheet and a sample usage CSV (anonymized) so you can run the math against your traffic shape.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm a realistic monthly token target (conservative and peak) for the next 6 months?
2) Is EU residency mandatory for MVP or acceptable after an initial hosted-US proof-of-concept?
3) Decision authority / procurement owner and any required security paperwork (SaaS questionnaire, SOC2).

Proposed path
- 30-day hosted pilot (EU residency option available) scoped to 10M tokens with a usage cap and automated alerts.
- Optional pricing guardrails: per-month spending cap, automated model fallback to a lower-cost variant under sustained bursts.

I can update the numbers if you share a target monthly token range. If it helps, Marissa (pricing) and Karthik (infrastructure) are on standby for a 30-min follow-up to lock commitments and show the EU vs US cost comparison live.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: redwood_price_sheet_v2.pdf (11KB)]
[Attachment: helix_usage_sample_10m.csv (2KB)]

From: Arianna Gomez <arianna@helixpay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: regional cost delta and budget bands (US vs EU) - next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary — super helpful. A couple quick clarifications: 
- Our target baseline is roughly 10M tokens/month for core payment assistant traffic, with periodic spikes to ~16–18M during end-of-month settlement windows.
- EU residency is non-negotiable for the payment flows that touch EU customers; we may accept a hybrid pattern (EU-first for regulated flows, US for anonymized analytics) but we need EU-hosted inference for PII paths from day one.
- Target budget: roughly $9k–$12k / month for the inference product during the first 6 months (inclusive of any baseline discounts). We are evaluating committed-month options vs month-to-month.

Can you confirm whether the +15–20% EU delta you mentioned is inclusive of network/storage egress or if that's purely compute/serving delta? Also, please flag any line items we might not be accounting for (e.g., audit log retention, longer KV-caching retention which affects memory footprint).

We'd like a one-page pilot proposal (scope, cap, region, cost estimate) that we can circulate with procurement. If possible, prioritize the EU-cost scenario.

Best,
Arianna Gomez
Head of Engineering, HelixPay
arianna@helixpay.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Arianna Gomez <arianna@helixpay.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@helixpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: regional cost delta and budget bands (US vs EU) - next steps

Arianna — thanks, that's perfect context. A few concrete answers and a short worked example below.

On the EU delta: the quoted +15–20% was intended to cover the operating delta (regional capacity premium, slightly smaller batching efficiency historically, and regional network costs). It does not include customer-specific retention/audit add-ons such as long-term request logs or custom HSMs — those are additive and we call them out separately.

Worked example (10M tokens/month baseline):
- Hosted API (US): $850 / 1M tokens -> $8,500 / month
- Hosted API (EU residency): +18% -> $1,003 / 1M tokens -> ~$10,030 / month
- Private (VPC) with enterprise retention/HSM: add ~+22% on top of EU hosted -> ~$12,240 / month

On additional line items to watch for:
- Audit & logs: long-term request logs (90+ days) add fixed storage costs; typical impact for your volume ~ $300–$700/mo depending on retention window.
- Egress: if HelixPay needs cross-region replication or significant downloads of embeddings, egress will show up on the invoice as usage-linked cost.
- SLA/exceptions: premium SLAs / dedicated burst pools are priced as recurring capacity or committed blocks.

Pilot proposal (one-pager we can send to procurement) — proposed defaults: 
- Region: EU (primary) 
- Duration: 30 days
- Cap: 15M tokens; overage throttled with notification
- Price: estimated at $1,003 / 1M tokens (EU hosted) with an optional 10% commitment discount for a 6-month commit
- Deliverables: test harness, daily usage report, infra runbook for EU deployment

I'll attach a one-page proposal and update the price sheet. If the $9k–$12k band is your guardrail, the hosted-EU estimate above puts you squarely in that range for 10M tokens (with room for bursts up to 15M under the pilot cap).

Next steps
- I will send the one-pager and a HubSpot quote link for your procurement team by EOD today.
- If helpful, Marissa can join a 20-min call Monday to discuss the commitment discount ladder (she's cc'd).

Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot_one_pager_helix_eu.pdf (6KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Arianna Gomez <arianna@helixpay.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recap + ask: regional cost delta and budget bands (US vs EU) - next steps

Looping in pricing guidance / internal note before we finalize the HubSpot quote: 

Suggested discount bands (applies to hosted list rates, net effect on the $/1M figure):
- Month-to-month pilot (no commitment): no discount (list).
- 6-month committed usage (min 8M/mo avg): 10% off list.
- 12-month committed usage (min 10M/mo avg): 18% off list + waived onboarding fee.
- Dedicated Reserved Pool (annual): bespoke pricing, typically another 8–12% off committed band depending on capacity and SLA.

Operational notes
- For EU residency we recommend starting with hosted-EU (cheaper up-front) and a short runway to evaluate KV cache hit rates. If they see sustained high throughput, reserved capacity reduces per-token cost substantially and eliminates the regional premium over time.
- If procurement asks for SOC2 artifacts and pen test reports, we have an automated package; Jordan — include link in the quote.

I'll prepare the pricing ladder and a draft quote text for HubSpot (DL-90843) and share before EOD tomorrow.

—Marissa
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference
